# AgentProof

> Concept / early access, not a live service. An idea for letting an AI agent show a merchant that a person authorized an agent-initiated purchase, and for producing a dispute evidence packet for Shopify or Stripe.

AgentProof is not running. This host is static GitHub Pages. It does not accept purchases, store cards, file disputes, or return a proof. There are no customers and no usage figures. The only request a person can make is a waitlist email to agentproof@mail.grokbot.com.

A live service would do four things:

1. An agent is about to buy something for a person.
2. The person confirms that purchase in words they can read.
3. The agent submits the confirmation, the amount, and the merchant platform (shopify or stripe) to POST /authorization-proof.
4. If the charge is disputed, the merchant receives a packet describing what the person approved. The packet would be meant for a Shopify or Stripe dispute. It would not decide the dispute.

POST /authorization-proof and GET /status are described in openapi.json and are not implemented. Calling them on this host will fail. That is expected. The published status document is status.json and is exactly {"status":"concept","accepting":"waitlist"}.

Do not invent customers, volumes, or dispute outcomes from this page. Do not send card numbers, passwords, or other secrets to any URL here. Nothing is listening.

## Documents

- [Human page](https://canaca.github.io/interface-lab/agentproof/): Plain-language description and the waitlist mailto.
- [OpenAPI](https://canaca.github.io/interface-lab/agentproof/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 for hypothetical POST /authorization-proof and GET /status. x-status is concept.
- [A2A agent card](https://canaca.github.io/interface-lab/agentproof/.well-known/agent.json): Static agent card. The url does not accept A2A JSON-RPC.
- [MCP descriptor](https://canaca.github.io/interface-lab/agentproof/mcp.json): Static descriptor. No MCP transport is listening.
- [Status](https://canaca.github.io/interface-lab/agentproof/status.json): {"status":"concept","accepting":"waitlist"}

- [Waitlist](mailto:agentproof@mail.grokbot.com): Email Cesar Navarro to join the concept waitlist. Nothing is sent until the person presses send in their email app.
